scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/bot && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['packages/shared/dist','packages/bot/dist','packages/web/dist','packages/shared/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo','packages/bot/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo','packages/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(p, {recursive:true, force:true});"
